rules.description: RBAC and least-privilege yes/no must align between canonical truth and questionnaire row
rules.messageTemplate: RBAC or least-privilege assertion contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align the row with the canonical RBAC policy or update the canonical answer if practice has changed.

rules.description: Access request process (formal vs informal) must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: Access request process description contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Describe the same request channel and workflow as in the canonical policy.

rules.description: Access approval and segregation-of-duties stance must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: Access approval workflow contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Match manager approval, logging, and segregation-of-duties claims to the canonical workflow.

rules.description: Row must not claim informal approval patterns when canonical defines a controlled workflow
rules.messageTemplate: Row describes informal access approval that conflicts with the controlled workflow in the canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove informal approval language and align with the canonical approval path.

rules.description: Access review cadence in the row must match the cadence stated in the canonical answer
rules.messageTemplate: Access review frequency in the row does not match the canonical requirement
rules.resolutionGuidance: Use the same review cadence as the approved canonical answer.

rules.description: Offboarding row must not contradict canonical automated or timely deprovisioning
rules.messageTemplate: Offboarding description conflicts with the approved deprovisioning approach
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align with automated or SLA-driven deprovisioning described in the canonical answer.

rules.description: Privileged access enforcement yes/no must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: Privileged access enforcement contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align privileged access controls (JIT, PAM, break-glass) with the canonical policy.

rules.description: Privileged access row should reflect key concepts present in the canonical policy text
rules.messageTemplate: Privileged access answer is missing substantial policy language from the canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Incorporate the same control themes (e.g. JIT, logging, approval) as in the canonical text.

rules.description: When canonical mandates admin MFA, the row must explicitly mention MFA or equivalent
rules.messageTemplate: Canonical requires strong authentication for admins but the row does not mention MFA
rules.resolutionGuidance: State MFA/2FA for administrative access to match the canonical requirement, or update canonical if policy changed.
